description: The Estrella Polar survives the catastrophe and its passengers gradually realize the scale of what has happened, forcing the improvised community to ration resources, establish rules and investigate evidence that they may not be alone.

s01e01.description: Hours after the Estrella Polar leaves port, an impossible storm destroys communications and navigation; Julia realizes a particle-accelerator disaster has transformed the planet and hides how much she knows.

s01e02.description: While the younger crew still treats the voyage like an adventure, the adults search desperately for signs of land, functioning communications and an explanation for the vanished world.

s01e03.description: A passenger plane crashes beside the ship, prompting a mission to recover its black box as Palomares pushes for port because Vilma urgently needs medical care.

s01e04.description: With food, water and energy becoming critical, the crew discovers an unexplained government container holding a device with a countdown, while Ramiro insists the catastrophe may be an experiment.

s01e05.description: Tens of thousands of starving birds descend on the Estrella Polar searching for rest and food, while family and romantic tensions intensify aboard the isolated ship.

s01e06.description: Food rationing fuels a challenge to the captain’s authority just as an enormous current drags the powerless ship toward a dangerous underwater obstacle.

s01e07.description: The crew wakes to unnatural darkness, failing electronics and a useless compass, raising the terrifying possibility that the ship has been carried somewhere completely unexpected.

s01e08.description: A gigantic sea creature threatens the Estrella Polar, forcing Ulises and Julia to devise a cage and hunting plan before the animal can damage the ship.

s01e09.description: The crew locates a yacht broadcasting a distress signal but finds nobody answering aboard, while Burbuja’s head injury unexpectedly restores fragments of his forgotten life.

s01e10.description: An unnatural wall of toxic fog approaches the ship, Ainhoa’s situation with Gamboa collapses and Gamboa attempts to leave in a life raft after confronting Ulises.

s01e11.description: With Gamboa missing and presumed dead, Ramiro accuses Ulises of murder and maritime law forces the captain to put his own passenger on trial.

s01e12.description: Burbuja finds the first captain’s log and learns of a mysterious Liverpool passenger, leading the crew to discover that the ship contains a hidden thirty-first cabin.

s01e13.description: Gamboa returns in suspiciously good condition, Julia and the captain clash over what he knows, and every phone aboard suddenly receives the same SOS coordinates from possible survivors.
